entity_level_taxes.name: Corporate franchise tax on S corporation built-in/entity-level items
entity_level_taxes.notes: Utah Code 59-7-701 says an S corporation is taxed at the 59-7-104 rate, which S.B. 60 (2026) cut from 4.5% to 4.45% retroactive to 2026-01-01; applies only to income taxed at entity level federally. C corporations pay a $100 minimum; whether that minimum applies to S corps was not verified (tax.utah.gov blocked).

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: A pass-through entity that is not disregarded may elect to pay tax at the individual rate in 59-10-104(2) (4.45% for 2026) on voluntary taxable income; election made by payment on or before the last day of the taxable year, irrevocable.

personal_exemption.notes: No standard deduction or exemption; instead a nonrefundable taxpayer tax credit = 6% of the federal standard (or Utah itemized) deduction + 6% of the Utah personal exemption ($1,750 per qualifying dependent, indexed). The credit is reduced by 1.3 cents per dollar of state taxable income above base amounts (statute text: $15,095 single, $22,643 HoH, $30,190 joint, indexed annually; 2026 indexed values not read because tax.utah.gov is blocked).

estimated_tax.required_if: No quarterly estimated payment schedule in statute; to avoid the penalty, pay by the return due date the lesser of 90% of current-year tax or 100% of prior-year tax (Utah Code 59-10-516(2)).
estimated_tax.notes: Utah has no quarterly estimate requirement for individuals (prepayment rule applies on the extended return). Not confirmed on tax.utah.gov (blocked).

unemployment_2026.notes: Wage base read only from the search-indexed text of jobs.utah.gov (direct fetch 403); overall rates 0.1%-7.1%. New employers get an industry-average rate (no single figure).

notable: Flat rate cut again for 2026: 4.5% to 4.45%, retroactive to 2026-01-01, also for corporations (https://le.utah.gov/Session/2026/bills/enrolled/SB0060.pdf)

No standard deduction: a 6% taxpayer credit phases out at 1.3% of income above a base amount, so the effective marginal rate is ~5.75% in the phase-out range (https://le.utah.gov/xcode/Title59/Chapter10/59-10-S1018.html)
Elective pass-through entity tax at 4.45% for partnerships and S corps (https://le.utah.gov/xcode/Title59/Chapter10/59-10-S1403.2.html)
No local income taxes on self-employment income
